claim: Edinburgh Fringe accommodation should be booked 4-6 months ahead; best-located rooms gone by January/February, with festival pricing 2-3x normal Edinburgh rates.
quote: The best-located rooms are gone by January or February. ... Festival pricing tends to be 2-3x normal Edinburgh rates.

claim: Edinburgh Fringe 2026 accommodation runs roughly hostel dorms £45-80, budget chains £150-300, mid-range £250-500, with Airbnb basic rooms around £200/night at peak.
quote: if you can stretch to about £200 a night you should be able to get a fairly basic single or double bedroom at peak Fringe

claim: Edinburgh Fringe 2025 issued more than 2.6 million tickets across 3,893 shows, fractionally down on 2024's 2.61 million.
quote: more than 2.6 million tickets were issued across 3,893 shows ... fractionally down on 2024, which registered almost 2.61 million tickets

claim: During Fringe (1-24 Aug 2025) High Street, Parliament Square, Cockburn Street and St Giles' Street were closed to vehicles 10.30am-midnight (10.30am-9pm weekends).
quote: High Street, Parliament Square, Cockburn Street and St Giles' Street were closed to vehicles between 10.30am to midnight (10.30am to 9pm Saturday and Sunday)

claim: Oktoberfest 2026 (Sep 19-Oct 4) draws ~6 million visitors; hotels near Theresienwiese reach €300-500/night on weekends versus €80-150 normal Munich rates, peaking on the second weekend.
quote: anything within walking distance of the Theresienwiese can reach €300 to €500 ... on weekends, with average room prices hitting their peak on the second festival weekend

claim: Oktoberfest bans bags over 3 litres (20x15x10 cm), deploys ~600 police, over 2,000 security staff, 50+ cameras and a 5.5km flight-restriction zone.
quote: Approximately 600 police officers ... Over 2,000 security staff ... More than 50 cameras ... a 5.5-kilometer flight restriction zone overhead

claim: On 27 Sep 2025 ~300,000 simultaneous visitors forced Oktoberfest to close main entrances amid stampede fears; Munich introduces digital crowd measurement and professional announcers for 2026.
quote: approximately 300,000 visitors crowded the Theresienwiese simultaneously ... Police closed main entrances ... 2026: Digital crowd measurement systems will replace current mobile phone data estimates

claim: Venice Carnival 2026 sees ~3 million visitors over the period with daily crowds of 150,000-200,000 in Piazza San Marco; book 6-8 months ahead as occupancy hits 95-100% and rates double.
quote: Carnival attendance reaches 3 million visitors ... daily crowds of 150,000-200,000 people filling San Marco square ... Book accommodation 6-8 months ahead ... hotels reach 95-100% occupancy with prices doubling normal rates

claim: Venice Carnival inflates hotel rates 200-300%, with mid-range rooms €180-450/night and San Marco often exceeding $400; Carnival runs Jan 31-Feb 17 2026 with peak crowds on Giovedì and Martedì Grasso.
quote: Carnival inflates rates 200-300%, with expectations of €180-450/night for mid-range hotels

claim: Venice's day-tripper access fee returns in 2026 but Carnival dates fall outside the fee window, so Carnival visitors do not pay or preregister.
quote: since Venice Carnival visits occur outside of the Access Fee dates, visitors won't have to register or pay a fee

claim: Oktoberfest advises avoiding U4/U5 and Theresienwiese station, using Schwanthalerhöhe, Goetheplatz or Poccistraße instead; the Theresienwiese station may close temporarily after tents shut to prevent overcrowding.
quote: use alternatives to U-Bahn 4/5 and U-Bahn station Theresienwiese ... After the tents close, the station may be closed temporarily to prevent overcrowding
